synopsis: VTD is among the tools supporting ASAM OpenSCENARIO XML and OpenDRIVE; the glossary explains that these languages describe scenarios and roads, respectively [f8616, f16017]. Both the tools chapter and glossary list VTD as an example commercial platform in the highest-cost validation tool chain, but these facts provide no VTD-specific price [f9303, f16166]. Cadence’s acquisition of Hexagon D&E, including VTD, closed on 23 February 2026 [f8880]. The supplied facts establish standards support, cost-tier positioning and an ownership milestone, but do not establish VTD-specific suitability for heavy off-road braking validation [f8616, f16017, f9303, f16166, f8880].

relations.note: Both list VTD as supporting OpenSCENARIO and OpenDRIVE.
Both include VTD among commercial platforms in the highest-cost example tool chain.
